owner_brief: Owner, 2026-10-20: work on the videos now, with a male voice, voice interactions, and a visual plan and motion plan for each scene of each video.

voice.speaker: omar
voice.name: Dr. Omar
voice.description: Male, late 30s, friendly, confident and relaxed; international English, a light Gulf Arabic accent is welcome; medium-low pitch; about 140 words per minute (00_program/narration-and-lexicon.md).
voice.rule: Dr. Omar is the only voice in every clip. Noor may appear as art (never speaking). Lines are spoken to one person, 'you', in the present tense.

facts: Dr. Omar is a family physician at J2

clips.title: Code Red drill briefing
clips.placement: new unscored video screen BEFORE the drill game hs2-030 (plan says 'after hs2-030'; see open questions)
clips.message: Remember RACE, then run the drill.

facts: Smoke from Consultation Room 3 on the first floor
